sections.title: How the learning flow works
paragraphs: Each module is designed as one continuous learning journey instead of a collection of disconnected pages.
You can study the material, practice with immediate feedback, and then move to the exam when you are ready.
bullets: Study: organized explanations and key points.
Exam: timed or untimed assessment with final analytics.

callout.label: Prototype note
callout.text: The educational content on this page is only a UI demonstration. Real Study content will be generated from your uploaded course materials.

sections.title: Navigation that never leaves you stuck
paragraphs: Every page shows where you are and provides a clear next action or a clear way back.
Your exam progress can also be saved on the same device so you can continue where you stopped.
